methodology.all_symbols: Go symbol declarations already indexed by Wingless ICE
methodology.source_reviewed: Curated against exact source files and recorded SHA256 identities
methodology.syntactic_call_candidates: Parser syntax; no dynamic dispatch, type resolution, or runtime control flow guarantees
methodology.source_state: Only source identities from pinned commit; no runtime, broker, research, or acceptance effect
methodology.review_evidence: Source-reviewed labels carry pinned source commit, file SHA-256, exact declaration line spans and source literal anchors checked by Windows qualification; local package dependencies are explicitly file-level and do not prove a function call.
methodology.uniform_source_proof: Every source-reviewed declaration carries pinned source identity, exact source-line span, verified literal evidence and source-indexed FILE-LEVEL local package imports; file imports are not function calls.
